The attacker-controlled CBOR map is parsed into libcbor items.
A map key with tag value 14 selects the version-scheme parser for the corresponding CBOR integer value.
The helper accepts any unsigned CBOR integer width and does not require that the item is encoded as a 16-bit integer before extracting it as one.
A small-width CBOR integer reaches cbor_get_uint16, which performs a two-byte read for an item that was not validated as having two payload bytes.
